name: Conegliano (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Conegliano (a yellow cross on blue) within branches, with five thin white horizontal stripes at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Conegliano, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 21 February 1972.
